primary_delta: Treat UnifiedDB as canonical transaction/replay/provenance truth and ClayGraph/EAP as a rebuildable model-input possibility preprocessor. Keep exact/packet/FTS/coherent direct routes as cheap first-class paths. After fail-closed natural-language seed resolution, compile only the bounded relational possibility slice required for the current ActiveAssembly; never expose the model to an unbounded database/graph scan and never let graph activation mint truth or effect authority.

supersedes_or_refines.reason: The earlier result correctly rejected always-on graph retrieval and required resident semantic indexing, adaptive routing, exact fallbacks and assembly certificates. The current EAP work implements the bounded escalation/preprocessor side rather than replacing those cheap routes.

evidence.result: Historical ClayGraph cycle recorded graph/graph-lexical about 84-87 ms versus SQLite FTS about 0.8-0.9 ms and rejected graph as an always-on hot path.

12,000 semantic nodes / 11,760 dependency edges / 240 queries: complete EAP Assembly recall=precision=nDCG@12=1.0; p50 about 92.57 us versus matched staged recursive SQLite model-input path about 104.19 us (~1.126x). Naked recursive SQL refs-only remained faster at about 43.06 us.

Held-out alias/abstention reconstruction: U12-style fail-closed resolver 33/33 decision-correct versus direct canonical lexical seed 22/33; resolver p50 about 66 us. Repository benchmark against the actual U12 implementation is committed but lacks a runner receipt.

6000 semantic nodes / 5880 dependency edges / 120 structure mutations: full rebuild update+next-query p50 about 8661 us versus incremental about 29.6 us (~292x) with exact selection equality. Current repository end-to-end StateLedger benchmark is committed but not remotely executed in this connector lane.
1800 hot traversals: exact Top-12 equality 100%; median frontier 40 -> 13 (-67.5%); pure traversal p50 about 20.28 -> 11.86 us (~1.71x).

12,000 semantic nodes / 11,760 dependency edges: approximate reachable EAP cache 14.98 MiB -> 8.78 MiB by discarding dependency row bodies (~41.4% saved), while canonical dependency rows remain in StateLedger.
Toy adversarial conflict bridge: output-only filtering precision@2=0.5; epistemic propagation gate precision@2=1.0. This is the exactly-one unusual experiment for this go cycle.

HippoRAG, LightRAG, LazyGraphRAG and 2026 query-aware spreading-activation research support graph-aware, incremental, budgeted and query-conditioned retrieval as useful regimes, but do not prove universal superiority for Clay.
Connector-generated push/issue/PR events produced no inspectable GitHub Actions run or persisted EAP receipt; runner execution remains UNKNOWN/BLOCKED_TRIGGER_LANE.

strongest_counterhypothesis: A simpler exact/FTS/online-SQL/U11 coherent path dominates EAP end-to-end once real natural-language coverage, StateLedger commit cost, process RSS, concurrent writes, recovery and downstream answer quality are counted; EAP should therefore remain conditional escalation rather than replacing cheap database routes.
